summary: Entry map for Kit's Marinara Engine authoring corpus. The collection routes characters, personas, and Convo profiles; Conversation schedules and custom media; sprites, galleries, colors, and stats; visual assets and card CSS; lorebooks; prompts, macros, and the exhaustive macro catalog; agents, custom tools, regex, memory, and Professor Mari; chat interchange and group behavior; maps, game state, HUDs, scenes, and storyboards; data layout, backup, and SillyTavern import; and the source-coverage manifest. Authority pins Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine commit b7545a63e7e264a1cd9eeea1a5490d50c08ddb29 retrieved 2026-07-26 under AGPL-3.0. Questions should open the narrow owning page and read the complete surrounding section. Upstream behavior never proves Hoplight adapter support: the Marinara format page governs implemented preservation, and SillyTavern macro behavior must not be projected onto Marinara.

The Hoplight pages are independently worded rather than a verbatim mirror. Implementation claims about what Hoplight can preserve belong to the Marinara format adapter reference.
